briefLinkBroken.title: This draft was not guided by the brief

qa.countsNotEvaluated: No checks have run for this deliverable yet.
qa.scopeNote: {advisory} of the {total} checks in this run are advisory: they are recorded as passed even when they match, and never change the conclusion above. Not checked this run: duplication against outside content, facts beyond this project's own data, and brand tone.

blocker.title: Cannot pass review yet
blocker.body: {count} reference(s) in this draft cannot be checked against the research records frozen for this run. This is not a run failure — the run finished, and both the draft and the records were produced and are readable.
blocker.more: and {count} more, listed under the checks above
blocker.why: Why: this run's research records are assembled only from data already confirmed inside this project, with no outside retrieval. An outside source cited in the draft therefore has nothing here to be checked against. That is the boundary of this stage, not a defect.
blocker.next: Next: send the draft back for more evidence, or write a new revision without the references that cannot be checked and run it again.

qa.publishNote: This stage publishes nothing. Passing review produces a reviewed revision and nothing else: no CMS, Git or third-party publishing target is written. Results only observe whether the technical condition was fixed — never traffic, rank or conversion.

blockedReceipt.staleBody: This deliverable already has a newer revision (currently revision {current}). Your review named revision {target}; it was not recorded and nothing changed. Read the new revision and review that instead.

history.title: Versions this screen holds
history.subtitle: Two points, not a full history: there is no operation that lists every revision of a deliverable.
history.currentRow: Revision {revision} — the text on screen now
history.judgedRow: Revision {revision} — the revision the automated checks judged
history.briefRow: Content brief revision {revision} — frozen into this run
history.noRevision: No revision has been produced yet
history.note: Every revision keeps its own body, frozen input fingerprint and the automated verdict of its time; a revision is never overwritten.

publish.label: Publish to CMS · unavailable at this stage
publish.note: This stage connects to no CMS, Git or third-party publishing target. Passing review produces a reviewed revision and nothing else.

compare.draftFrozenNote: You are reading revision {frozen} — the text this run froze and checked. The deliverable is now on revision {current}, which nothing on this screen has compared against the brief.
compare.noCommittedTopics: The frozen cluster contributed no target keyword, so there is no committed topic list to compare against.
compare.coverageUnevaluated: Coverage was not judged this run, so nothing below is marked either way — compare the two panes by hand.
compare.briefUnavailable: The frozen brief revision could not be read, so only its committed topics are shown.
compare.draftUnavailable: This run has produced no draft body yet.

report.title: Report
report.heroTitle: Turn one evidence set into a report your client can act on.
report.subtitle: The client-facing view of this engagement: coverage, confirmed findings, the 30/60/90 plan, and ready deliverables.
report.executiveSummaryNote: A compact decision frame built only from the confirmed findings, canonical roadmap, and ready deliverables below.
report.evidenceFrameValue: {count, plural, =0 {No confirmed findings are included yet.} one {# confirmed finding anchors this brief.} other {# confirmed findings anchor this brief.}}
report.programShapeValue: {count, plural, =0 {No canonical actions are planned yet.} one {# canonical action is sequenced across the roadmap.} other {# canonical actions are sequenced across the roadmap.}}
report.deliveryStateValue: {count, plural, =0 {No deliverable is ready for handoff yet.} one {# validated deliverable is ready for handoff.} other {# validated deliverables are ready for handoff.}}
report.clientContextNote: The delivery frame below comes from the canonical project configuration for {host}.
report.outputLocaleHelp: This request localizes the methodology and sets the locale for a new export. Clear it to use the project delivery locale. Findings, actions, and deliverables keep their recorded languages, shown below.
report.dataCoverageNote: Coverage reflects which signals were available for this analysis. Unavailable data is never estimated or shown as zero.
report.findingsNote: Confirmed findings, each with a client-readable summary and the key evidence behind it.
report.planNote: Recommended actions organized across the 30 / 60 / 90-day horizon.
report.artifactsNote: Ready execution deliverables prepared for this engagement. Drafts are excluded until finalized.
report.nextStepLead: {count, plural, =0 {Review the canonical roadmap before assigning an execution owner.} one {Approve the # action in the first 30-day lane and assign its owner.} other {Approve the # actions in the first 30-day lane and assign their owners.}}
report.nextStepBody: Keep the evidence references and ready deliverables attached as the work moves from decision to execution.
report.noPromise: This report documents observed signals and recommended actions. It does not predict, guarantee, or promise any ranking, traffic, or revenue outcome.
report.clientBundleNote: The client bundle excludes internal observations, notes, provider usage, ignored or needs-more-data findings, and non-final artifacts. The service bundle contains the full internal record.
report.manifestDescription: Canonical contents and integrity metadata for this generated bundle.
report.clientIncluded: Client-safe report data and ready deliverables
report.clientExcluded: Internal observations, notes, and non-final content
report.serviceIncluded: Canonical service data, observations, evidence, actions, and artifact revisions
report.serviceExcluded: Secrets, credentials, tokens, and restricted provider usage details

report.exportDependencyUnavailable: The export service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
